body:
Hi!  We have a NORD report about this condition and we are requesting to add the following synonyms: 

GRINopathies 

GRIN-related Encephalopathy 

GRIN-related Neurodevelopmental Disorder 

GRIN-related complex neurodevelopmental disorder 

References

Santos-Gómez A, Miguez-Cabello F, García-Recio A, et al. Disease-associated GRIN protein–truncating variants trigger NMDA receptor loss-of-function. Hum Mol Genet. 2021.

Santos-Gómez A, Miguez-Cabello F, Juliá-Palacios N, et al. Paradigmatic de novo variants recapitulate pathophysiological mechanisms underlying GRIN1-related disorder clinical spectrum. Int J Mol Sci. 2021.

Gjerulfsen CE, Krey I, Klöckner C, et al. Spectrum of NMDA receptor variants in neurodevelopmental disorders and epilepsy. Methods Mol Biol. 2024.

Benke TA, Park K, Krey I, et al. Clinical and therapeutic significance of genetic variation in the GRIN gene family encoding NMDARs. Neuropharmacology. 2021.

GRIN database: A unified and manually curated repertoire of GRIN variants

Thank you! Gioconda Alyea

comments.body: Hi @galyea123, we will be adding all the synonyms requested but would like to confirm if GRINopathies should be GRINpathies or grinpathies as in https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34884460/. Thanks

title: Request to add synonyms to: GRIN-related complex neurodevelopmental disorder (MONDO:1060138)
